@Polynomial.leadingCoeff_dvd_leadingCoeff : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
  {a p : Polynomial R}, a ∣ p → a.leadingCoeff ∣ p.leadingCoeff

@Polynomial.leadingCoeff_pow : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (p ^ n).leadingCoeff = p.leadingCoeff ^ n

@Polynomial.leadingCoeff_linear : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {a b : R} [inst : Semiring R],
  a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C b).leadingCoeff = a

@Polynomial.pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) (a : R),
  (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p ∣ p
@Int.natAbs_le_of_dvd_ne_zero : ∀ {m n : ℤ}, m ∣ n → n ≠ 0 → m.natAbs ≤ n.natAbs
@Int.le_abs_of_dvd : ∀ {a b : ℤ}, b ≠ 0 → a ∣ b → a ≤ |b|

@one_le_pow_mul_abs_eval_div : ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]
  {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|
